title.en: Attentive clinical team and varied feedback

text.en: Several clients praise clinicians like Nora and the nursing team for their knowledgeable, friendly approach and understanding manner during stressful visits. However, one owner reported significant dissatisfaction after a vet failed to act during an acute canine seizure. Overall, visitors highlight an otherwise efficient and helpful staff.

title.en: Prompt medical care and treatment outcomes

text.en: Pet owners commend the surgery for effective treatments, including cancer surgery recovery, rapid foreign body removal, and same-day blood test results. Conversely, one reviewer felt let down when an urgent neurological concern went untreated without referral. Most reviewers express gratitude for the positive care their pets received.

Clients describe the surgery on Fulham Road as spotlessly clean, modern, and organised with a welcoming atmosphere. Pet owners appreciate the calming environment, which helps reduce anxiety for sick animals and their handlers. Visitors note that the clean clinical surroundings contribute to a professional standard of pet care.

q.en: Can the clinic provide rapid diagnostic blood test results?

a.en: Yes, clients mention receiving blood test results on the same day during their clinic consultations.

q.en: Does Chelsea Veterinary Surgery handle surgical procedures?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe successful surgeries including complex procedures and foreign body interventions.
The practice is located at 364-366 Fulham Road in the Chelsea area of London.
